lastCompletedStory.title: Budget oracle-lint and auditor re-plan rounds independently

nextStoryContext: runPlanPhaseWithReplan (src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts) now tracks TWO independent round budgets instead of one: MAX_LINT_REPLAN_ROUNDS (new, =2) for audit-blocked rounds whose origin is 'oracle-lint', and the pre-existing MAX_REPLAN_ROUNDS (unchanged name and value =2) for origin 'auditor'. Continuation and exhaustion are both gated by the LATEST round's own block origin (helpers bumpReplanBudget/replanBudgetRemains, extracted to stay under biome's cognitive-complexity ceiling -- see the new patterns.md bullet on the type-predicate narrowing trap if a future story touches this loop guard again). Worst-case total rounds per plan call is now MAX_LINT_REPLAN_ROUNDS + MAX_REPLAN_ROUNDS (up from MAX_REPLAN_ROUNDS alone) -- an accepted, bounded cost, not a regression. The CAM-447 pathology test (test/supervisor/plan-runner.test.ts, was 'mixed: round-1 lint-block then round-2 real auditor BLOCK both fold into the SAME escalation path') is REWRITTEN (not deleted) to assert the new non-escalating (audit-approved) outcome for that same round-1-lint / round-2-auditor-BLOCK scenario; the AC4 pure-lint-every-round escalation test and the pure-auditor spawn-cycle pin were left behaviorally unmodified and both still assert roundsCompleted/spawn-count == MAX_REPLAN_ROUNDS (2), which only holds because MAX_LINT_REPLAN_ROUNDS was ALSO set to 2 -- if a future story wants to change the lint budget's numeric value independently of the auditor budget's, that AC4 pin (test/supervisor/plan-runner.test.ts) needs re-deriving, not just a constant bump. docs/adr/0052 documents the Decision/Consequences for this split.
